label: Mourning of Family opportunity for Martin
text:
You can hold a pro-man funeral for <color=#D09B61FF>Martin</color>.

To begin the ritual, select a grave containing Martin's corpse and click the 'Begin Mourning of Family' command.

Expires in <color=#87F6F6FF><color=#87F6F6FF>9 days</color></color>, on 10th of Jugust.

label: Death: Martin
text:
(*Name)Martin(/Name) has died. Cause: Blood loss.

(*Name)Martin(/Name) should be buried and given a funeral so his friends and family can say farewell.

label: Game Over
text:
Everyone is dead or gone. This story is over.

Perhaps someone else will find a use for the ruins of this place.

label: Create new wanderers
text:
Everyone is dead or gone. Perhaps someone will find a use for the ruins of this place.

Choose new wanderers arrive at your colony and continue the story.

label: Rare thrumbos
text:
A small herd of thrumbos have wandered into the area.

Peaceful by nature, these rare creatures are extremely dangerous when confronted. Some traders are willing to pay a lot of money for their precious leather and horn.

Thrumbos will leave the area in a few days.

label: Flashstorm
text: A freak localized flashstorm is striking a small area with lightning. This can cause massive fires.

label: Area revealed
text: A new area has been revealed.

label: Cargo pods
text:
You have detected a cluster of cargo pods crashing nearby.

Perhaps you'll find something useful in the wreckage.

label: Mourning of Family opportunity for Martin
text:
You can hold a pro-man funeral for <color=#D09B61FF>Martin</color> even though the body was lost.

To begin the ritual, select an empty grave to mourn Martin's passing and click the 'Begin Mourning of Family' command.

Expires in <color=#87F6F6FF><color=#87F6F6FF>9 days</color></color>, on 12th of Jugust.

label: Meteorite: Gold ore
text: A large meteorite has struck ground in the area. It has left behind a lump of gold ore.
